# 2 Chronicles Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-queen-of Sheba heard report-of Solomon and-she-came to-test Solomon with-riddles to-Jerusalem with-a-train great very and-camels bearing spices and-gold for-abundance and-stones precious and-she-came to Solomon and-she-spoke with-him all that was with her-heart.

**2** And-he-told to-her Solomon all her-words and-not was-hidden a-thing from Solomon that not he-told to-her.

**3** And-she-saw queen-of Sheba wisdom-of Solomon and-the-house that he-built

**4** and-food-of his-table and-seating-of his-servants and-standing-of his-attendants and-their-clothing and-his-cupbearers and-their-clothing and-his-upper-chamber that he-went-up to-house-of YHWH and-not was in-her anymore spirit.

**5** And-she-said to the-king true was the-word that I-heard in-my-land about your-matters and-about your-wisdom.

**6** And-not I-believed their-words until that I-came and-they-saw my-eyes and-behold not was-told to-me the-half-of greatness-of your-wisdom you-have-surpassed the-report that I-heard.

**7** Happy are-your-men and-happy are-your-servants these the-standing before-you continually and-hearing your-wisdom.

**8** May-be YHWH your-God blessed who delighted in-you to-put-you on His-throne as-king for-YHWH your-God in-love-of your-God for-Israel to-establish-them forever and-He-made-you over-them as-king to-do justice and-righteousness.

**9** And-she-gave to-the-king a-hundred-and-twenty talents-of gold and-spices for-great abundance and-stones precious and-not was like-the-spice that which gave queen-of Sheba to-the-king Solomon.

**10** And-also servants-of Huram and-servants-of Solomon who brought gold from-Ophir brought trees-of algum and-stones precious.

**11** And-he-made the-king the-trees-of the-algum walkways for-house-of YHWH and-for-house-of the-king and-harps and-lyres for-the-singers and-not were-seen like-them before in-land-of Judah.

**12** And-the-king Solomon gave to-queen-of Sheba all her-desire that she-asked besides that which she-brought to the-king and-she-turned and-she-went to-her-land she and-her-servants.

**13** And-was weight-of the-gold that came to-Solomon in-year one six-hundred and-sixty-and-six talents-of gold

**14** apart-from men-of the-traders and-the-merchants bringing and-all kings-of Arabia and-governors-of the-land bringing gold and-silver to-Solomon.

**15** And-he-made the-king Solomon two-hundred large-shields of-gold beaten six-hundred of-gold beaten he-put upon the-large-shield one.

**16** And-three-hundred shields of-gold beaten three-hundred gold he-put upon the-shield one and-he-put-them the-king in-house-of forest-of the-Lebanon.

**17** And-he-made the-king a-throne great of-ivory and-he-overlaid-it with-gold pure.

**18** And-six steps to-the-throne and-a-footstool in-gold to-the-throne they-were-fastened and-armrests from-this-side and-from-this-side on place-of the-sitting and-two lions standing beside the-armrests.

**19** And-twelve lions standing there on the-six steps from-this-side and-from-this-side not was-made like-it for-any kingdom.

**20** And-all vessels-of drinking-of the-king Solomon were-gold and-all vessels-of house-of forest-of the-Lebanon were-gold refined nothing-of silver it-was-not accounted in-days-of Solomon for-anything.

**21** For ships-of the-king were-going to-Tarshish with-servants-of Huram once to-three years they-came ships-of Tarshish bearing gold and-silver ivory and-apes and-peacocks.

**22** And-he-was-great the-king Solomon more-than-all kings-of the-earth for-riches and-wisdom.

**23** And-all kings-of the-earth were-seeking face-of Solomon to-hear his-wisdom that put God in-his-heart.

**24** And-they were-bringing each-one his-gift vessels-of silver and-vessels-of gold and-garments armor and-spices horses and-mules a-matter-of year in-year.

**25** And-there-were for-Solomon four-thousand stalls for-horses and-chariots and-twelve-thousand horsemen and-he-placed-them in-cities-of the-chariot and-with the-king in-Jerusalem.

**26** And-he-was ruling over-all the-kings from the-River and-to land-of the-Philistines and-to border-of Egypt.

**27** And-he-made the-king the-silver in-Jerusalem as-the-stones and-the-cedars he-made as-the-sycamores that are-in-the-Shephelah for-abundance.

**28** And-they-were-bringing-out horses from-Egypt for-Solomon and-from-all the-lands.

**29** And-rest-of acts-of Solomon the-first and-the-last are-they-not written in-words-of Nathan the-prophet and-in-prophecy-of Ahijah the-Shilonite and-in-visions-of Iddo the-seer concerning Jeroboam son-of Nebat.

**30** And-he-reigned Solomon in-Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

**31** And-he-lay-down Solomon with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-city-of David his-father and-he-reigned Rehoboam his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **9:8**: on His-throne as-king for-YHWH — Unique to Chronicles: the queen says Solomon sits on God's throne, not merely a human throne. The Davidic king rules as God's earthly representative.

- **9:13**: six-hundred and-sixty-and-six talents — A specific annual income figure. Whether symbolic or historical, the number represents extraordinary wealth.

- **9:29**: words-of Nathan...prophecy-of Ahijah...visions-of Iddo — The Chronicler's source citations reference prophetic writings now lost, indicating a rich literary tradition beyond the biblical canon.


— EMET
